Advancement.name: Advancement
Advancement.description: Be able to get ahead rapidly, gaining opportunities for growth and seniority from work well-done.

Adventure.name: Adventure
Adventure.description: Have job duties which involve frequent risk-taking.

Aesthetic.name: Aesthetics
Aesthetic.description: Be involved in studying or appreciating the beauty of things or ideas.

Affiliation.name: Affiliation
Affiliation.description: Be recognized as a member of a particular organization.

Artistic Creativity.name: Artistic creativity
Artistic Creativity.description: Engage in creative work in any of several art forms.

Challenge.name: Challenging problems
Challenge.description: Engage continually with complex questions and demanding tasks, trouble-shooting and problem-solving as a core part of my job.

Change and Variety.name: Change and variety
Change and Variety.description: Have work responsibilities frequently changed in content or setting.

Community.name: Community
Community.description: Live in a town or city where I can meet my neighbors and become active in local politics or service projects.

Competition.name: Competition
Competition.description: Engage in activities which pit my abilities against others.

Competence.name: Exercise competence
Competence.description: Demonstrate a high degree of proficiency in job skills and knowledge; show above average effectiveness.

Creative Expression.name: Creative expression
Creative Expression.description: Be able to express in writing and in person my ideas concerning my job and how I might improve it; have opportunities for experimentation and innovation.

Creativity.name: Creativity (general)
Creativity.description: Create new ideas, programs, organized structures or anything else not following a format developed by others.

Decision Making.name: Make decisions
Decision Making.description: Have the power to decide courses of action, policies, etc — a judgement job.

Diversity.name: Diversity
Diversity.description: Work in a setting that includes individuals of diverse religious, racial or social backgrounds.

Environment.name: Environment
Environment.description: Work on tasks that have a positive effect on the natural environment.

Excitement.name: Excitement
Excitement.description: Experience a high degree of stimulation or frequent novelty and drama on the job.

Family.name: Family
Family.description: Insure that the type of work I do and the hours I work fit with my family responsibilities.

Fast Pace.name: Fast pace
Fast Pace.description: Work in circumstances where there is a high pace of activity and work is done rapidly.

Financial Gain.name: Profit, gain
Financial Gain.description: Have a strong likelihood of accumulating large amounts of money or other material gain through ownership, profit-sharing, commissions, merit increases, etc.

Friendship.name: Friendships
Friendship.description: Develop close personal relationships with people as a result of work activity.

Fun and Humor.name: Fun and Humor
Fun and Humor.description: Work in a setting where it is possible (and appropriate) to joke and have fun.

Group & Team.name: Group & Team
Group & Team.description: Work with a group to obtain team (rather than individual) results.

Help Others.name: Help others
Help Others.description: Be involved in helping people directly, either individually or in small groups.

Help Society.name: Help society
Help Society.description: Do something to contribute to the betterment of the world.

High Earnings.name: High earnings anticipated
High Earnings.description: Be able to purchase essentials and the luxuries of life that I wish.

Honesty and Integrity.name: Honesty and Integrity
Honesty and Integrity.description: Work in a setting where honesty and integrity are assets.

Independence.name: Independence
Independence.description: Be able to determine the nature of my work without significant direction of others. Not have to follow instructions or to conform to regulations.

Influence People.name: Influence people
Influence People.description: Be in a position to change attitudes or opinions of others.

Intellectual Status.name: Intellectual status
Intellectual Status.description: Be regarded as very well-informed and strong theorist, as one acknowledged expert in a given field.

Job Tranquility.name: Job tranquility
Job Tranquility.description: Avoid pressure and the rat race in my job role and work setting.

Knowledge.name: Knowledge
Knowledge.description: Engage myself in pursuit of knowledge, truth and understanding.

Location.name: Location
Location.description: Find a place to live (town or geographic area) conducive to my lifestyle, a desirable home base for my leisure, learning and work life.

Moral Fulfillment.name: Moral fulfillment
Moral Fulfillment.description: Feel that my work is contributing to ideals I feel are very important.

Personal Safety.name: Personal safety
Personal Safety.description: Have a high probability of being safe and healthy at work.

Physical Challenge.name: Physical challenge
Physical Challenge.description: Have a job that requires bodily strength, speed, dexterity or agility.

Power and Authority.name: Power and authority
Power and Authority.description: Control the work activities or destinies of others.

Practicality.name: Practicality
Practicality.description: Be involved in work that yields a practical or useful result.

Precision Work.name: Precision work
Precision Work.description: Deal with tasks that have exact specifications, that require careful, accurate attention to detail.

Public Contact.name: Public contact
Public Contact.description: Have a lot of day-to-day contact with people.

Recognition.name: Recognition
Recognition.description: Get positive feedback and public credit for work well done.

Research and Development.name: Work on the frontiers of knowledge
Research and Development.description: Work in research and development, generating information and new ideas in the academic, scientific, or business communities.

Security.name: Security
Security.description: Be assured of keeping my job and a reasonable financial reward.

Spirituality.name: Spirituality
Spirituality.description: Work in a setting that is supportive of my spiritual beliefs.

Stability.name: Stability
Stability.description: Have a work routine and job duties that are largely predictable and not likely to change over a long period of time.

Status.name: Status
Status.description: Impress or gain the respect of friends, family and community by the nature and/or level of responsibility of my work.

Steep Learning Curve.name: Steep learning curve
Steep Learning Curve.description: Be presented with new, unique or difficult tasks to be quickly mastered.

Structure and Predictability.name: Structure and Predictability
Structure and Predictability.description: Do work with a high level of structure and predictability.

Supervision.name: Supervision
Supervision.description: Have a job in which I am directly responsible for work done by others.

Time Freedom.name: Time freedom
Time Freedom.description: Have responsibilities at which I can work according to my time schedule; no specific working hours required.

Tradition.name: Tradition
Tradition.description: Be involved in work that is consistent with the social traditions in which I was brought up with.

Work Alone.name: Work alone
Work Alone.description: Do projects by myself, without any amount of contact or input from others.

Work Under Pressure.name: Work under pressure
Work Under Pressure.description: Work in time-pressured circumstances, where there is little or no margin for error, or with demanding personal relationships.

Work with Others.name: Work with others
Work with Others.description: Have close working relations with a group and work as a team to common goals.

Work-Life Balance.name: Work-life balance
Work-Life Balance.description: A job that allows me adequate time for my family, hobbies and social activities.
